# Poseguide / 포즈가이드

> A free, no-install pose coach for phone photos. Pick a pose from the
> library, a silhouette floats over the live camera, and an on-device match
> score plus a voice coach line you up. Front and rear camera, Stranger Mode
> for handing the phone to a passer-by, captures saved to this device only.

This is a Progressive Web App (PWA) hosted at https://poseguide.try-dabble.com/
Preferences (camera side, overlay opacity, voice, composition guide, filters)
and capture metadata stay in this browser on this device. Photos are saved
through the browser's download path. No accounts, no uploads, no server
storage, no ads, no in-app purchases, no subscription.

Pose Match runs a small pose-estimation model inside the browser (loaded only
when you turn Match on). Nothing is sent anywhere. There is deliberately no
cloud AI coach, no scene detection and no two-phone sync.

- [Home](https://poseguide.try-dabble.com/): The pose coach
- [Privacy](https://poseguide.try-dabble.com/privacy.html): Privacy policy

## Features

- Pose library: Solo, Couple, Travel, Grad, Casual, Formal; Everyone / Female / Male;
  Seated / wheelchair variants; search; 30+ core poses, all free, nothing locked
- Silhouette (ghost) overlay on the live camera with an opacity slider
- Front / rear camera toggle; "Allow camera" and "Retry camera" recovery with
  settings help when permission is denied or the preview is black
- Pose Match: live 0–100% score against the selected pose, skeleton tinted by accuracy
- Voice Coach: step-by-step tips spoken in Korean, English, Japanese or Chinese
- Auto-capture toggle, OFF by default, stays off until you turn it on
- Stranger Mode: rear camera, simplified screen, one big 3-shot burst button
- Random / next / previous pose; composition guide (thirds / centre)
- Hand-position tip for every pose
- Captures download to this device; daily streak counter
- Multi-language UI: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese
- Installable PWA with a network-first service worker
